clue: This process describes how water moves around Earth. It includes evaporation, condensation, and precipitation. It explains how water travels between oceans, clouds, and land.
This process happens when liquid water turns into water vapor. Heat from the sun usually causes it. It is an important step in the water cycle.
This process occurs when water vapor cools and changes into liquid water. It forms clouds in the sky. It is another key part of the water cycle.
This occurs when water falls from clouds to Earth. It can include rain, snow, sleet, or hail. It happens when clouds become too heavy with water droplets.
This shows how energy moves from one living thing to another. It usually starts with the sun and plants. Animals eat other organisms to get energy.
This includes living and nonliving things interacting in the same place. Plants, animals, water, and soil can all be part of it. Forests, deserts, and ponds are examples.
This organism can make its own food using sunlight. Plants and algae are examples. They form the base of most food chains.
This organism cannot make its own food. It must eat plants or other animals to survive. Many animals fall into this category.
This organism breaks down dead plants and animals. Fungi and bacteria often perform this role. They return nutrients to the soil.
This is the natural home of a plant or animal. It provides food, water, and shelter. Different species need different types of these places to survive.
This is a feature that helps an organism survive in its environment. It can be a physical trait or behavior. Camouflage and thick fur are examples.
This force pulls objects toward Earth. It is the reason things fall when dropped. It also keeps planets in orbit around the sun.
This force happens when two surfaces rub against each other. It slows objects down. Without it, walking would be very difficult.
This object can attract certain metals like iron. It has north and south poles. Opposite poles attract while like poles repel.
This is a closed path that electricity follows. It usually includes a power source, wires, and a device like a light bulb. The path must be complete for electricity to flow.
This is the ability to do work or cause change. It can exist in forms such as heat, light, and motion. The sun is a major source of it for Earth.
This form of energy moves from warmer objects to cooler ones. It can cause changes in temperature. It often comes from the sun or burning fuels.
This state of matter has a definite shape and volume. The particles are packed closely together. Examples include ice, wood, and metal.
This state of matter has a definite volume but no fixed shape. It takes the shape of its container. Water is a common example.
This state of matter has no definite shape or volume. The particles spread out and move freely. Air is a mixture of these substances.
This describes the conditions of the atmosphere at a certain place and time. It includes temperature, precipitation, and wind. It can change from day to day.
This describes the long-term weather patterns of a region. It is based on data collected over many years. Deserts and rainforests have very different ones.
This process moves soil and rock from one place to another. Water, wind, and ice can cause it. It slowly changes Earth’s surface.
This process breaks down rocks into smaller pieces. It can happen because of water, wind, or temperature changes. It often occurs before erosion.
This is the preserved remains or trace of a living organism from long ago. They are often found in rock layers. Scientists study them to learn about ancient life.
This system includes the sun and everything that orbits it. Planets, moons, asteroids, and comets are part of it. Earth is one of the planets in this system.
This star is at the center of our solar system. It provides light and heat to Earth. Plants use its energy to grow.
This natural satellite orbits Earth. It reflects sunlight, which is why we can see it at night. Its phases change during the month.
